checks.reason: For h^{ab}=delta g^{ab}, volume variation has minus one-half; Palatini scalar variation and two integrations by parts give F G_ab+(g_ab Box-nabla_a nabla_b)F.
Matter convention delta S0=-1/2 integral sqrt|g| T0_ab h^{ab} gives 2F G=T0+2(nabla nabla-gBox)F. With F=1/(2kappa^2)+xi u, equation E has coefficients 1+2kappa^2 xi u and 2xi.
For the same metric-null k, G(k,k)=Ric(k,k); the g Box term vanishes. N, H and D follow with the signs displayed. No division by 1+2kappa^2 xi u occurs.

The loops have 3*3*2*2=36 exact rational cases. They set T0 from N, so test rearrangement only, explicitly disclosed. Omission values 4/3 and -1/3 and h=u*r cancellation follow by inspection. They are not metric/field solutions or functional-variation tests.

Stationarity is a named remaining premise; the derivation does not construct a stationary field, identify recordSource with Ttotal, or supply universal H3. GeneralSourceEinsteinBridge equivalence is reused without mistaking it for a source law.
u fixed in metric variation is required. If u contracts a covector with the metric, its additional variation is not covered; text makes this exclusion explicit.
On-shell Ttotal conservation from Einstein/Bianchi is valid for constant G, but is not independent off-shell material conservation; circular use is explicitly excluded.

Reviewed relevant source ranges for matter-density variation, metric/Ricci variation, wave conservation, record decoding, area equivalence, current paper action and algebraic nonminimal-coupling scope. All eleven manifest source hashes match.
Read publisher article equations 12,14,15: its half-f action, f_R and Hessian-minus-metric-box tensor agree with f=2FR and f_R=2F. No external bytes archived or hash claimed.
